Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Khris Middleton?

Khris Middleton is 34 years old.

Where was Khris Middleton born?

Khris Middleton was born in Charleston, South Carolina.

When was Khris Middleton born?

Khris Middleton was born on August 12, 1991.

How tall is Khris Middleton?

Khris Middleton is 6-7 (201 cm) tall.

How much does Khris Middleton weigh?

Khris Middleton weighs 222 lbs (100 kg).

Is Khris Middleton in the Hall of Fame?

Khris Middleton is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Khris Middleton drafted?

Khris Middleton was drafted by Detroit Pistons, 2nd round (9th pick, 39th overall), 2012 NBA Draft.

What position does Khris Middleton play?

Small Forward and Shooting Guard.

What is Khris Middleton's net worth?

Khris Middleton has made at least $290,198,451 playing professional basketball.

How much does Khris Middleton make?

Khris Middleton made $37,948,276 in 2023.

How many rings does Khris Middleton have?

Khris Middleton has won one championship.

What is Khris Middleton's Instagram account?

Khris Middleton is on Instagram at k_mid22.

What schools did Khris Middleton attend?

Khris Middleton attended Porter-Gaud School in Charleston, South Carolina and Texas A&M.

What are Khris Middleton's nicknames?

Khash Money, WD-40, Baby Joe Johnson are nicknames for Khris Middleton.
